signals.thesis: RobCo's jump to a $1B valuation marks a new unicorn in European industrial robotics, a sector markets are watching for signs of automation capex and competition with US/Chinese robotics players. Strong HN engagement (214 points, 184 comments) signals notable attention to European deep-tech funding momentum.
signals.title: RobCo reaches $1B valuation, becoming German robotics unicorn

signals.thesis: A data breach in Denmark has exposed personal data for 8.8 million people, a scale significant relative to the country's population and likely to trigger regulatory scrutiny under GDPR and renewed cybersecurity market attention. High HN engagement (297 points, 230 comments) reflects strong interest in the incident's scope and fallout.
signals.title: Denmark breach exposes 8.8M personal records

signals.thesis: A new technique lets the 125B-parameter Qwen 3.8 Flash Next model run at 100 tokens/sec on a single RTX 4090, lowering the hardware bar for large-model inference and pressuring the economics of cloud-based AI serving. The post drew strong HN traction (860 points, 386 comments), indicating high developer interest in on-device/local large-model deployment.
signals.title: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next enables 125B-parameter inference on consumer GPUs
